== Summary ==
Identified: [[Brian Fred]] and [[Dennis Reinhardt]]. Remaining faces unlabeled.
Eventual champion Brian Fred plays Dennis Reinhardt in Game 6 of the main event. Both reached the Top 8., at the [[2026 World Championship]] (Hyatt Regency Bloomington by Mall of America, Bloomington, Minnesota).
